role.zh: 创意合作伙伴与官方创作者

detail.en: AI short films, visual development and creator-led product practice across image and video generation.
detail.zh: 围绕图像与视频生成，开展 AI 短片、视觉案例与创作者侧产品实践。

detail.en: Selected for the official program, exploring cinematic storytelling, character and scene consistency, motion, and multi-shot continuity.
detail.zh: 入选官方精英创作者计划，以影视叙事与镜头语言探索角色、场景一致性、动态表现与多镜头衔接。

detail.en: AI short films, platform content and creative workflow case studies.
detail.zh: 围绕 AI 短片、平台内容与创作流程案例开展内容合作。

detail.en: Prototype testing, product feedback and workflow advice informed by filmmaking and camera language.
detail.zh: 从电影制作与镜头语言出发，参与原型测试、产品反馈与创作工作流设计。

detail.en: Multi-model AI filmmaking and creative workflow exploration across image and video.
detail.zh: 开展多模型 AI 影像创作与流程测试，连接图像生成、视频生成与创意开发。
